doc.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09

title: Goodbyes and station sign-off
summary: Ramsey thanks the guests, wishes Pete luck with the new club; the announcer closes.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: He did, you know. Right. Mm-hmm. Sir, we're going to have to cut you off. We're out of time. Thank you very much. Thank you. Thanks for calling. Gentlemen, thanks for coming down. Eddie, it was a pleasure to see you again. Thank you, Doug. It's always a pleasure. Pete, good luck with your new club in Jefferson Parish. Scared to death. Oh, yeah. Oh, well. That's not great. Have a pleasant Super Bowl weekend. Thank you, Doug. I hope the business is good.
I know it will be. We were supposed to work it, but it looks like we're not going to work a bowl. Oh. Something came up.

Well, tonight our guest on the television version of Close Up will be Dr. Charles Merry, the new director of Charity Hospital. Mike Kettenring will also be with us. I hope you can all join us. Have a pleasant evening.

This is NBC in New Orleans, WDSU AM at 1280 on your dial. Stay tuned for NBC News on the hour. Next, we'll have music on the Bob Middleton Show in just five minutes from now, and a special correspondence report, 1970 from NBC from 830 until 9 o'clock tonight. All happening on WDSU. The temperature is 34 degrees. We've got clear skies in New Orleans right now. We expect a low temperature reading tonight of around 30 to 34 degrees. Delta Airlines time is 8 o'clock.
